# Convert to billions of dollars (thousands / 1,000,000)

x = [float(y) for y in years]
y = [receipts_billions[y] for y in years]

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", y)
print()

# OLS: slope = sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)^2)

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"ybar = {ybar}")
print(f"slope = {slope}")
print(f"intercept = {intercept}")
print()

# Round to 3 decimal places
slope_rounded = round(slope, 3)

print(f"intercept (rounded) = {intercept_rounded}")
